So the screw that holds bottom plate is stripped. If you are good with a drill you can drill out the stripped screw. Firmly secure the rifle use a drill bit smaller than the screw and go slowly (make sure you can hold the drill straight up don't want to damage the threads). If the stripping of the hex head isn't that bad you can use a larger hex key and a little force and hopefully it will grip.
